verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say you can issue physical cards for in-person employee spend and virtual cards, with controls attached to each (ramp-docs-7, ramp-docs-11). Spend limits come from funds with amount, interval, merchant and country restrictions (ramp-docs-41, ramp-docs-9). Speed is supported by 'instant virtual cards' with per-vendor limits (ramp-docs-31) and templates that make issuing 'just one click' (ramp-docs-47). Missing for 10: details on how quickly physical cards are issued and shipped, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the 'in minutes' claim.
